chapters.title: Hash set during any traversal

frames.caption: Hash set during any traversal — O(n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: find_target(root=tree (5), k=9). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
node = stack.pop() — (5) popped off the end of stack
node = stack.pop() — (6) popped off the end of stack; node moves to (6)
node = stack.pop() — (7) popped off the end of stack; node moves to (7)
stack += [node.left, node.right] — stack is now [(3), None, None, None]
node = stack.pop() — None popped off the end of stack; node = None
node = stack.pop() — None popped off the end of stack
node = stack.pop() — None popped off the end of stack
node = stack.pop() — (3) popped off the end of stack; node moves to (3)

chapters.title: Two pointers with forward and backward iterators

frames.caption: Two pointers with forward and backward iterators — O(n) time, O(h) extra space. Input: find_target(root=tree (5), k=9). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node moves to (3)
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node moves to (2)
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node = None
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node moves to (6)
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node moves to (7)
node = node.left if forward else node.right — node = None
while lo and hi and lo[-1] is not hi[-1]: → true
